paths.scope: Linux/AMD64 owner-user native desktop and local services

validation.merge_gate: All required release PR CI must pass before merge. Manual upgrade review and stable publication are separate.
user_confirmed: Agent Help launch and continued session lifetime

scope_limits: Linux/AMD64 owner-user service upgrade in an offline Arch/Omarchy VM, schema47 to59, Vere4.6 and the pinned Recommended Apps pill. Fresh-install distro testing has its separate acceptance matrix.

The automated service controls use an exact-program Polkit denial/retry fixture. Human password entry is left for the separate manual-review VM; remote service upgrades and power loss are outside this rehearsal.
Real desktop cold/hot activation and failed-candidate recovery ran separately in a private compositor. The service guest loader used harness activation acknowledgments.

The fleet test uses restricted SSH and a private routed client namespace with actual Theme/DMs helpers and Secret Service; it does not certify a live Tailnet, Cloudflare account, public DNS or TLS provider.

The installed runner CLI scenario covers source staging, create/commit gates and Clay source publication. Native three-peer Treaty/frontend delivery is separately tested with a synthetic managed lifecycle backend.
Large preview uses a sparse file. Full import uses only a small stopped fake and synthetic metadata.
